_note: Seed/demo CVE dataset for offline matching against nmap service/version banners. Thresholds are best-effort and NOT a substitute for a full NVD feed or live vulnerability intelligence — extend this file or wire core/cve_matcher.py to a live feed for production use.

_schema.product_match: list of lowercase substrings matched against the nmap 'product' field (and service name as fallback)
_schema.min_version: affected if detected version >= min_version (null = no lower bound)
_schema.max_version: affected if detected version < max_version (null = no upper bound)
_schema.public_poc: optional curated map of public exploit references (e.g. {'metasploit': 'module/path'}); absent means 'not curated', NOT 'no PoC exists'

entries.name: Heartbleed
entries.description: OpenSSL TLS heartbeat extension out-of-bounds read allows remote attackers to read process memory (private keys, session data).
entries.remediation: Upgrade to OpenSSL 1.0.1g or later and rotate all certificates/keys.

entries.name: vsftpd 2.3.4 backdoor
entries.description: vsftpd 2.3.4 as distributed from a compromised source contains a backdoor triggered by a ':)' smiley in the username, granting a remote shell on port 6200.
entries.remediation: Upgrade to a clean vsftpd build >= 2.3.5 from an official source.

entries.name: OpenSSH user enumeration
entries.description: OpenSSH before 7.8 allows remote attackers to enumerate valid usernames via a timing/behavioral difference during authentication.

entries.name: Apache HTTP Server path traversal / RCE
entries.description: Path traversal in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 allows mapping URLs to files outside the document root; combined with mod_cgi can lead to RCE.
entries.remediation: Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.51 or later.

entries.name: nginx resolver off-by-one
entries.description: Off-by-one heap write in nginx's DNS resolver, triggerable via crafted DNS responses, can lead to memory corruption.

entries.name: ProFTPD mod_copy RCE
entries.description: ProFTPD's mod_copy module allows unauthenticated remote attackers to copy files anywhere on the filesystem via SITE CPFR/CPTO, enabling RCE.
entries.remediation: Upgrade to ProFTPD 1.3.5b or later, or disable mod_copy.

entries.name: SambaCry
entries.description: Samba allows a malicious client to upload a shared library to a writable share and cause the server to load it, resulting in RCE.
entries.remediation: Upgrade to Samba 4.6.4, 4.5.10, or 4.4.14 (or later) per branch.

entries.name: Exim 'Return of the WIZard'
entries.description: Exim before 4.92 has a remote command execution flaw reachable under certain non-default configurations via crafted recipient addresses.

entries.name: BIND assertion failure (deny-answer-aliases / allow-query-cache)
entries.description: BIND servers with deny-answer-aliases configured can crash due to a REQUIRE assertion failure when processing crafted responses.

entries.name: Ghostcat (Tomcat AJP)
entries.description: The Tomcat AJP connector allows reading/including arbitrary files on the server, and can lead to RCE if file uploads are permitted.
entries.remediation: Upgrade Tomcat and disable/restrict the AJP connector if unused.

entries.name: Jenkins CLI RCE via Stapler
entries.description: Jenkins' Stapler web framework allows crafted URLs to access internal methods, enabling unauthenticated RCE in several reported chains.

entries.name: Redis Lua sandbox escape (cjson heap overflow)
entries.description: A heap overflow in Redis's bundled Lua cjson library can be triggered via the EVAL command, leading to RCE on the Redis server.
entries.remediation: Upgrade to a patched Redis release (6.2.7, 7.0.0, or later per branch) or disable scripting (EVAL) for untrusted clients.

entries.name: PHP-CGI query string RCE
entries.description: PHP configured via CGI mishandles query strings, allowing attackers to pass arbitrary command-line arguments to the PHP interpreter.
entries.remediation: Upgrade PHP to 5.4.2/5.3.12 or later and avoid running PHP directly via php-cgi.

entries.name: IIS 6.0 WebDAV ScStoragePathFromUrl buffer overflow
entries.description: IIS 6.0's WebDAV service has a buffer overflow in ScStoragePathFromUrl reachable via a crafted PROPFIND request, allowing RCE.
entries.remediation: Decommission IIS 6.0 (EOL) or disable WebDAV; migrate to a supported IIS version.

entries.name: Log4Shell
entries.description: Apache Log4j2 JNDI lookup feature allows remote code execution via crafted log messages containing attacker-controlled JNDI lookups.
entries.remediation: Upgrade to Log4j 2.17.1 or later; if upgrading isn't possible, remove the JndiLookup class.
